metadata.native_build: CMake Release; C++20; sequential isolated workers; exact node reserve
metadata.native_sampling: Fixed input per order/size; SHA-256-derived rotation seeds consumed by buffered SplitMix64. Native strategies share seed values but consume different bit counts; Python MT streams are not paired.
metadata.native_timing: Insertion and aggregate counters only; input generation/parsing, node reservation, startup and final validation excluded. Sequential native workers on the same host; no Python timing comparison.
metadata.execution: Sequential isolated C++ workers; Python generates inputs and orchestrates trials.
metadata.sampling: Fixed input per order/size; SHA-256-derived rotation seeds consumed by buffered SplitMix64. Native strategies share seed values but consume different bit counts; Python MT streams are not paired.
metadata.metrics: Mean rotations/key, final mean node depth, maximum final height, logical random bits/key; native insertion seconds, ancestor visits and peak RSS. Root depth is zero.
metadata.limits: Per-worker address-space cap and wall deadline include insertion and final validation. A failed strategy/order stops its repeated and larger trials; these remain explicit not_run records.
metadata.validation: Every complete tree passes BST ordering, parent links, cycle detection, and exact input-key checks.
